changes: The app opens instantly from the last league update saved on your phone, then refreshes to live scores within seconds.
Works on weak signal or offline: a notice shows when you're viewing saved scores, and updates resume automatically.
New League Rules page (More → Help): trade deadline, playoffs, waivers, roster and full scoring, pulled live from ESPN.
One consistent accent color on every page, a fixed color for each team, and larger small text.
Retired the Trade Analyzer, Stat Fixes and casino games (Blackjack, Sportsbook, Slots). Extras stays in More.

history.title: Shortcut row polish
changes: Rounded page shortcuts stay side by side in a single swipeable row.
The shortcut scrollbar is hidden, including on mobile.

history.title: Shortcut button styling
changes: Restored the original rounded shortcut buttons at the top of each page.
Mobile shortcuts fit within the page and wrap when needed, without a scrolling strip or scrollbar.
